data.body:
[P1] Preserve quarantine across runs when retirement fails

A durable execution can become terminal while invocation-owned tasks remain alive. The coordinator then calls `finish(..., quiescent=False)`, but this implementation discards that signal. After the job releases its concurrency slot, the next deployment checks only for RUNNING executions and can update the persistent target despite unretired workers. Persist target quarantine and require subsequent preparation/deployment to reconcile the outstanding runtime work before clearing it. Add a two-run regression with a terminal execution and an unexited task.
